english: Was it okay to land in the middle of this forest?
It's fine, it's fine.\nThe enemy won't know\nwhat we're up to either, right?
From here it's a mind game.
If they've got Black Rika-chan,\nshe knows Hinamizawa well -\nbut so do we, so we've got the edge in making the first move.
Still, since we don't know\nthe scale of the enemy's defenses,\nit's hard to judge how to move.
It's not hard at all. Right, Satoko?
Yes. It's easier to move in the forest.
This forest is like\nour own backyard.\nWe're safer here.
Safer?
This forest is perfect\nfor ambushes and setting traps.
Which means there's definitely enemies here.
Then wouldn't avoiding it be the normal thing to do?
Getting surrounded without noticing -\nno thanks!
O-hohoho!\nI won't make such a mistake.
The enemy has set traps.\nAnd those will become the enemy's own weak point.
You're saying you can see where the enemy is?
Well.\nI may not see them, but\nI know as if they were in my hand!
You sound like a master of the art…
For example, there.\nSee the tree in front of Houki-san?\nThere's an intrusion-detection tripwire strung there.
Really!?
It's true! With my hyper sensor\nI can see a thin wire strung there!
Also, in the bushes\nto Charlotte-san's right,\nsomething's set in the ground.
How do you know?
I once dug a pitfall there,\nso the soil is soft.
I've imagined setting traps in this forest countless times,\nso I know the terrain.
No one anywhere can use this forest\nbetter than I can!\nO-hohoho!!
When it comes to making traps,\nno one beats Satoko.\nHer uncle's always getting caught by them too.
I choose to believe everyone's\nhappily getting caught?
I never thought\nSatoko's trap knowledge\nwould come in handy like this.
True… if you know it that well,\nyou might be able to play them like a fiddle.
However, whoever set these traps\nseems to be as skilled as I am.
Probably the black me… thinking about it\ngets me excited.
Satoko-san,\nyou've got quite a strong heart.\nI'm impressed!
Getting stronger is my goal.\nI'm still growing, you know?
Alright, we're breaking through here.\nSatoko and I take point - IS pilots,\nguard the flanks and rear!
I'll guard Sonozaki and Houjou.
I'll protect Rika-san and the others, desuu!
I'll guard Rika-chan from the middle!
Thank youu.
My… there are traps\nall over the place.
Can we advance while disarming them?
The traps alone, yes, but\nthere are likely ambushers\nstationed here.
Considering they'll target us while we disarm,\nwe should only disarm the dangerous ones\nand handle the rest as we fight.
Do you know where the ambushers might be?
Yes. The clearing past the narrow path,\nthe blind spot where the trees line up,\nand dead ends look suspicious.
Also, wherever ambushers lurk,\nthere's sure to be some trap.\nPlease be careful.
For an elementary schooler, she's one hell of a strategist.\nReassuring.
Future defense minister, decided?
Should I scout her\nfor the Special Disaster Response Mobile Unit, I wonder?
Whoa, offers like that go\nthrough Club President Mion.
Before that, we break through here, big sis.
Right! Everyone, move out!
…You've come.
…I considered the possibility\nthat you'd come this way.
So you've shown yourselves.\nWhat are you plotting here!
Oyashiro-sama's power… I'll take it.
If you know what Oyashiro-sama's power is,\nyou must know\nit's futile.
It's not for you to decide whether it's futile.
The one who set traps in this land -\nthe black me, meaning you?
I'm strong… I've become strong.\nNo one will bully me anymore…
If you think so, then don't even think\nabout kidnapping Rika.
Well then.\nYour so-called strength -\nshall I shatter it for you right now?
Ohh, they're coming out!
If we're prepared,\nthey're nothing to fear!
There they are!
Just like Satoko said!
There!
Expected!
Sorry, but you're going to die.
Haah-hah-hah-hah!\nYou're gonna die? Everyone!\nYou too! You too! You and you too!!
Wanna die? Wanna?
Every one of them's saying creepy stuff!\nIf we lose to the likes of them,\nthere's no telling what they'll do to us!
I don't even want to think about it…
Since you've come this far, you're prepared, right?\nWhatever happens is fine, right?\nYou can't complain about what we do to you, right?
If you're resolved, shut up and get in stance!\nBlabbering on just proves your spirit's gone soft!
You're the one who wants to die?\nFine, I'll torment you plenty,\nsqueeze out every drop of blood and tears!
I know now that I must never\nbecome like you.\nBecause everyone's here, I won't lose myself!
Damn! Falling back for now!
Hehe, come on over if you want to get gutted!
This world is already done for!\nIt's been invaded by aliens!
That's delusion… the truth lies elsewhere!
Lies!!
The showdown will have to wait, I wonderr
With Oyashiro-sama's power… I can redo it.\nEverything…
Not even Oyashiro-sama\ncan redo everything.
Don't push that resignation on me!
There's no chance.\nThat's why I'll stop you.
I won't give up! I'll defy fate!
Don't you really know?\nThat what you're doing is futile.
Were they trying to lure us in deeper?
It didn't feel like they came at us\nwith everything they had.
So the decisive battle isn't here, I wonderr
Their target should be Furude.\nBut I don't understand why\nthey're so fixated on Hinamizawa as the place.
…Then let me tell you.\nOyashiro-sama's power… the true secret\nthat only I and the black Rika would know.
The true…
Secret…?
Oyashiro-sama\nreally is here in Hinamizawa.
…Oyashiro-sama… exists…?
Really!?
Yes. Oyashiro-sama is visible\nonly to me, the shrine maiden of Furude Shrine.
So you really are a shrine maiden…
There's no need to fear Oyashiro-sama.\nShe doesn't kill people with curses,\nor turn people's hearts into demons.
Then what power does Oyashiro-sama have?
When I die,\nshe guides me to another world…
And the black Rika seeks that power.\nThat's why she had to come to Hinamizawa.
Can I ask one thing?\nCan the black Rika even find\nthis Oyashiro-sama?
No. She can't see Oyashiro-sama.\nOyashiro-sama only shows herself\nto those she wishes to.
In other words, unless they capture Rika\nand bend her to their will,\nthey can't obtain Oyashiro-sama's power?
Then wouldn't Rika-san be safe\nif she weren't in Hinamizawa, I wonder?
People of Hinamizawa are driven by a strong homing instinct\nand always return to Hinamizawa.\nWe can't live away from it for long.
…That means!
Yes. It's because of the endemic disease\nstudied as Hinamizawa Syndrome.
Then the me from back then -\nthe notes I got my hands on\nweren't wrong after all?
There's still a lot we don't know.\nBut to learn more, we must\nmove toward Hinamizawa's future.
No matter what,\nwe won't let Rika-chan die again!\nRight, everyone!
Of course!
Of course!
Never again… no more sad days!
No matter what traps are set,\nI'll see through every one of them!
Until now, I couldn't do anything for Rika,\nand it's been eating at me.\nBut this time, I'll save Rika!
For that, I'll throw in all my wisdom, strength, and heart\nand leave no regrets!
This battle in Hinamizawa - Satoko Houjou\nwill lead us to victory!
That's the spirit.\nI can't let myself lose either!
We'll protect Rika-chan with everything we've got.
I dedicate my sword to the shrine maiden of Hinamizawa.
Everyone… thank you…
//END
